metadata.description: dev-decide: an open-source, Jev-style decision engine for software and AI work

plugins.name: dev-decide
plugins.description: A Jev-style decision engine, open source and local: routes requests, triages issues, rates risk and gates pull requests with typed, calibrated answers. Answers locally in milliseconds when it can, asks Claude when it can't, and learns from every answer.

plugins.name: dev-decide-graph
plugins.description: A side panel for dev-decide: the decision graph of which agent or skill was suggested for which kind of task, what Claude really used, and timings. Needs the dev-decide plugin and Claude Code 2.1.310 or later.
